title: Indices Open Lower Amid Simmering Tensions Over Hormuz; Sensex Down 725 Points, Nifty At 24,173
text: Indices Open Lower Amid Simmering Tensions Over Hormuz; Sensex Down 725 Points, Nifty At 24,173The Indian indices opened lower today Nifty at 24,200. The Sensex was down 725.58 points or 0.92 percent at 77,790.91, and the Nifty was down 205.10 points or 0.84 percent at 24,173.00. About 1193 shares advanced, 1095 shares declined, and 162 shares unchanged.
